title: Evaluating ElevenLabs Music v2 for Your Next Music Workflow
markdown:
Disclosure: This article contains an affiliate link. Anicca is an independent ElevenLabs affiliate and may earn a commission if you subscribe through it, at no extra cost to you.

[Try ElevenLabs free](https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-music-en-1) on your own material before you pay. The Free plan has a small monthly credit allowance and no commercial license, so if you publish or monetize the output, compare the Starter and Creator plans first.

If you are deciding whether to add an AI music tool to a creative workflow, begin with the specific controls and delivery path you need. ElevenLabs presents Music v2 as a generator with controls for genre, mood, instruments, and structure; it also describes section-level inpainting, genre transitions, multilingual generation, and long-form composition. [Source: ElevenLabs Music](https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-music-en-1)

A practical evaluation can start with one brief: define the intended genre, mood, instrumentation, song structure, and language, then create a draft and revise one selected section. This maps the test to the controls ElevenLabs describes, including regenerating a selected section without changing the rest of the song. [Source: ElevenLabs Music](https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-music-en-1) For product teams, ElevenLabs also states that Music v1 and Music v2 are available through its API for generation, audio reference, inpainting, and long-form composition. [Source: ElevenLabs Music](https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-music-en-1)

Licensing should be reviewed against the planned use case before publishing. ElevenLabs says self-serve plans permit online and offline commercial use except for film, TV, and Studio Games, while Enterprise plans permit all online and offline commercial use; its music page links to the model-specific terms for further detail. [Source: ElevenLabs Music](https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-music-en-1)

Cost is another useful checkpoint. The official pricing page lists a Free plan with 10,000 monthly credits and a Starter plan at $6 per month with 30,000 credits; it says credits are shared across products and estimates Eleven Music usage at 900 credits per minute. Prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties. [Source: ElevenLabs pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing) Compare your expected music minutes with the available credit pool and verify the current plan details on the provider’s site.
